The plate looks square, about 20 cm across, so I treated it as a side plate. The photo is rotated 90°.

**Scrambled eggs:** They cover roughly 30% of the plate, about 100 cm² including the gaps. At a height of about 2.5 cm, that is about 150–200 cm³ of loosely packed eggs. I estimated about 110 g.

**Bacon:** There are two strips, each about 17 cm long and 2.5 cm wide. Cooked, a strip weighs about 8 g, so the pair comes to about 16 g.
